name: Folate (serum)
rangeNote: Serum folate reflects recent intake; one folate-rich meal can raise it. Below about 7 nmol/L (3 ng/mL) is usually considered deficient.
summary: Folate (vitamin B9) is needed to make DNA and new red blood cells. It comes from leafy greens, legumes and fortified foods.

high.meaning: A high folate usually comes from supplements or fortified foods and is not harmful in itself. High folate intake can hide the anaemia of vitamin B12 deficiency.

low.meaning: A low folate can lead to anaemia with large red cells. Before and in early pregnancy, enough folate is important for the baby.
commonCauses: Low intake of vegetables and legumes

sources.title: Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of cobalamin and folate disorders
